## Our take on the Pastel Hues Colored Pencils - Set of 24

Pastel Hues Colored Pencils is a 24-piece set of softly toned pencils meant for artwork, planners and school or office projects. The draw is the muted palette: delicate shades that blend into layered, low-contrast color rather than the bright primaries of a standard set. It suits journalers, letterers and hobby artists who want soft color, and it is rated for ages 3 and up. Against standard 24-count sets it trades vivid saturation for subtlety, so it is a complement to a bright set rather than a replacement.
